1). Keys with no significant deviation are Uncategorized. The dashed grey polygon is the median

svg.text: Each key receives a personality based on the audio feature with the highest z-score above the overall median (z > 1).
Keys with no significant deviation are Uncategorized.
Songs in this key have the steadiest beat and most groove-friendly
rhythms. High danceability relative to other keys.
Vocals take a backseat. These keys host more instrumental tracks:
ambient, classical, film scores, lo-fi beats.
You can hear the crowd. Tracks in this key have more "live" quality:
audience noise, stage energy, raw performance feel.
More spoken or rapped content than other keys. These tracks lean toward
vocal delivery, narrative, and word-heavy arrangements.
Happy, cheerful, euphoric: the sunniest key. High valence means the
music conveys positive emotion more than average.
